svg.title: Panel guide
svg.desc: Everything lives in the normal Forge workflow. The Ming panel appears only for Ming checkpoints.
svg.text: Where everything lives
No extra tab. Native preset, checkpoint and Generate. The Ming panel appears only when a Ming checkpoint is selected.
Native Forge (unchanged)
UI Preset → Ming-Image
Checkpoint → PROJECT INVISIBLE — Ming-Image
txt2img / img2img / Generate / Stop
Steps, CFG, size, seed, batch, gallery
A checkpoint change away from Ming releases the worker automatically.
Ming panel
Models — setup guide and download links
Speed — Spectrum acceleration (off by default)
Optional — RGBA, memory mode, keep loaded
LoRA dropdown and strength slider
img2img only: Extra reference images, slots 2–8.
What the engine ignores, stated plainly
Hires fix, inpainting masks, face restore, tiling, variation seeds and seed resize are rejected with instructions — never silently ignored.
Sampler and scheduler dropdowns map onto the backend's flow samplers; unsupported values fall back with a console note.
Denoising strength in img2img must be 1: Ming uses reference conditioning, not SD noise blending.
Every rejection is one clear line, not a broken image.
PROJECT INVISIBLE · MING-IMAGE-0.1-DESIGN · OCTOBER 1, 2026
